items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Crawford Ellis, you knew who Crawford Ellis was.

ctx.x: Well, it's from the, from the Times Picayune of 20th of September, 1950. I don't know. I can't, I don't. We can read that. Now that I've got the date, I can look it up in the newspaper. Here's a newspaper clipping.
Miss Crawford Ellis and Mrs. Frederick King, jazz jamboree, set for Thursday. Crawford Ellis, you knew who Crawford Ellis was.
Oh, they used to have Pan American life pictures.
